title: 404 comment sentences over 40 words in 99 files of the seat's cells
claim: Run over all 3781 D5 comment units of the seat's cells, 404 prose sentences (usage/code lines excluded, text_ledger's own sentence splitter) exceed criteria C5's 40-word bound, in 99 of 258 files; the longest is 166 words (tools/replay/export.py's module docstring).
mechanism: Long WHY paragraphs are written as one sentence chained by colons, semicolons and dashes; nothing checks length. Fails D5-criteria C5.

evidence.command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D5/s6/m4_ledger.py --repo <git checkout holding the baseline> --ref 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692
evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; count is contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: tools/audit/text_ledger.py:units_of (the D5 unit enumerator) over the cells' comments

perturbation.change: m4_ledger.py --c5-split tools/audit/seat/pr_args.sh (that file's units re-broken in memory every 30 words, as a fix would)

metric_definition: Count of sentences over 40 words in D5 comment units of D5-s6's cells (comment markers stripped, indented/command lines dropped, a backtick span one word).
phenomenon_property: Every repository path, script name, usage-line option and stated item count a comment unit or docstring in the seat's cells names resolves at the ref and agrees with what the code it sits on delivers (D5-criteria C1, C2)

proposed_fix_scope: Sentence splits in the comments only; no code change.
